Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misinterpreted the Wikipedia infobox in step 6, extracting "Bellevue, Ohio" as the birthplace when the page actually listed "New York, New York" (as confirmed in step 18). This data fabrication created a false conflict with IMDb, forcing the entire process into a lengthy and unnecessary verification loop involving AFI Catalog to resolve a discrepancy that did not exist.

Step Range: 0-2
The Oracle: John Francis Dillon

The Subtask Name: Retrieve birthplace from Wikipedia
Step Range: 3-6
The Oracle: Bellevue, Ohio
Evidence: Planner directs search for birthplace; WebSurfer searches and finds conflicting snippets (Bellevue, Ohio vs New York City); WebSurfer opens the Wikipedia page which initially shows Bellevue, Ohio in the viewport.

The Subtask Name: Retrieve birthplace from IMDb
Step Range: 7-8
The Oracle: New York City, New York, USA
Evidence: Planner directs to check IMDb; WebSurfer opens the IMDb biography page which clearly states "Born July 13, 1884 · New York City, New York, USA".

The Subtask Name: Retrieve birthplace from AFI Catalog
Step Range: 9-12
The Oracle: Unable to confirm from AFI Catalog (search failed to load specific bio)
Evidence: Planner directs to AFI; WebSurfer attempts to open AFI search page but only sees the homepage and search results list without the specific biography details containing birthplace.

The Subtask Name: Re-evaluate Wikipedia and confirm final birthplace
Step Range: 13-20
The Oracle: New York, New York
Evidence: Planner notes conflict and decides to re-verify; WebSurfer searches Wikipedia specifically for birthplace; WebSurfer opens the Wikipedia page again where the infobox clearly displays "Born July 13, 1884 New York, New York", resolving the conflict in favor of New York.
